summary_zh: 本页为绘本的标题页，竖排橙色文字显示书名「豆腐干丝王」和胖熊倒娘，背景为紫色。

title_en: Prince of 26 Tofu Strips and Fat Bear Chef
source_file: 26豆腐干丝王子和胖熊厨娘（7-10岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
从前，有位“豆腐干丝王子”。
怎么有这么奇怪的名字？
其实，王子本来并不叫这个名字，
他的全名是威风凛凛·十分英俊·万分聪明王子。
这是他的父亲狮子国王为他取的
名字。
可是这位王子的习惯
很糟糕，他平时就爱吃豆腐
干丝，其他什么菜都不爱吃，谁劝也没用，他是位非常任性的王子。
page_text_en:
Long ago, there was a 'Tofu Dry-Slice Prince'.
How could he have such a strange name?
Actually, the prince didn't originally have this name.
His full name was 'Majestic, Handsome, and Extremely Clever Prince'.
It was given to him by his father, the Lion King.
Name.
But this prince had a very bad habit.
He only loved to eat tofu dry-slices, and didn't like any other dishes. No one could persuade him. He was a very stubborn prince.
summary_zh: 本页介绍了故事主角‘豆腐干丝王子’的由来，解释了他奇怪名字的来源，并描述了他只爱吃豆腐干丝、性格任性的特点。

title_en: Prince of 26 Tofu Strips and Fat Bear Chef
source_file: 26豆腐干丝王子和胖熊厨娘（7-10岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
因此，狮子王子不可能得到很多营养。他长得非常瘦弱，长长的鬣毛无力地耷拉在脑袋上，挺像一把把豆腐干丝。由于营养不足，他整天无精打采的，脑袋也就不太聪明了。反正，他不像一只威武的狮子，

倒像一只留着长发的细长的狐狸，或者说像一只高个子哈巴狗。

他的同学都叫他“豆腐干丝王子”，后来简称为“干丝王子”，最后变成了“该死王子”了。
page_text_en:
Therefore, Lion Prince couldn't get much nutrition. He was very thin and weak, with his long mane limply hanging down on his head, looking like bunches of dried tofu strips. Due to poor nutrition, he was always listless, and his brain wasn't very sharp either. Anyway, he didn't look like a mighty lion,

but more like a long, slender fox with long hair, or perhaps like a tall, short-legged dog.

His classmates called him 'Tofu Strip Prince', later shortened to 'Strip Prince', and finally it became 'Dead Prince'.
summary_zh: 本页描述了狮子王子因只吃豆腐干丝导致营养不良，身体瘦弱、精神不振，外形被同学嘲笑，名字也从‘豆腐干丝王子’逐渐被戏称为‘该死王子’。

title_en: Prince of 26 Tofu Strips and Fat Bear Chef
source_file: 26豆腐干丝王子和胖熊厨娘（7-10岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
就因为爱吃豆腐干丝，就“该死”吗？
“没这个道理！”狮子国王可生气了，他要给王子找个好一点的厨师，
让他烧各种各样好吃的豆腐干丝，让
小王子胃口大开，长得结实强壮，看
谁还敢小看狮子王子。
国王把找厨师的告示张贴出去了，可是过了很久也没有人来揭榜。
每个厨师看到国王要找的厨师必须会烧咸干丝、甜干丝、醋溜干丝、麻辣干丝、红烧干丝、白煮干丝、五香干丝、怪味干丝以及其他各种各样的豆腐干丝，就都摇摇头走了。
page_text_en:
Just because he loves eating tofu dry strips, should he be called 'dead'?
"That's not fair!" The Lion King was furious. He wanted to find a better chef for the prince,
who could cook all kinds of delicious tofu dry strips,
so the little prince could eat heartily and grow strong and healthy.
Who would dare to look down on the Lion Prince anymore?
The king posted a notice to find a chef, but after a long time, no one came to take it.
Every chef who saw the king was looking for a chef who must be able to cook salty dry strips, sweet dry strips, vinegar-stir-fried dry strips, spicy dry strips, braised dry strips, boiled dry strips, five-spice dry strips, weird-flavored dry strips, and all kinds of tofu dry strips, just shook their heads and walked away.
summary_zh: 狮子国王因王子只吃豆腐干丝而被嘲笑，决定找一位能做出各种豆腐干丝的厨师，但因要求过于苛刻，无人应征。

title_en: Prince of 26 Tofu Strips and Fat Bear Chef
source_file: 26豆腐干丝王子和胖熊厨娘（7-10岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
谁想当个一辈子和豆腐干丝打交道的厨师呢——太乏味、太无聊了。
过了好久，终于有人来揭榜了。
这是一个长得挺和善的胖熊厨娘，她说她是一位有魔法的厨娘，能烧各种各样的豆腐干丝，保证能让王子吃得满意。
国王当然很高兴，马上就聘用了这位胖熊厨娘。
page_text_en:
Who would want to be a chef who spends their whole life dealing with tofu sticks? — Too boring, too dull.
After a long time, finally someone came to take up the challenge.
This was a kindly-looking fat bear chef. She said she was a magical chef who could cook all kinds of tofu sticks, and guarantee the prince would be satisfied.
The king was naturally very happy, and immediately hired this fat bear chef.
summary_zh: 国王为解决王子只吃豆腐干丝的问题，悬赏寻找厨师，最终一位自称有魔法的胖熊厨娘揭榜，并被国王立即聘用。

title_en: Prince of 26 Tofu Strips and Fat Bear Chef
source_file: 26豆腐干丝王子和胖熊厨娘（7-10岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
胖熊厨娘第一天上班，她走进王子的卧室说：“从今天起，我给你烧饭，但愿你能喜欢。我还带来一位朋友，那是一只又壮实又漂亮的狮子，你高兴的话，可以去找他玩。”

“真的吗？”王子高兴极了，因为平时很少有人愿意找他玩，他一直觉得挺孤单的，“那只又壮实又漂亮的狮子在哪里？我太想见他了。”

“他嘛——”胖熊厨娘系上围裙说，“他不在王宫的院子里，就在王宫外的草坪上；不在草坪上，就在山坡后面；不在山坡后面，就在小池塘边上……你去找他吧！”

王子高兴地飞奔出去了。

胖熊厨娘随后就生起炉子，架上锅，又煎又炒，又烧又煮，开始施展她的本领了。
page_text_en:
On her first day at work, the fat bear cook walked into the prince's bedroom and said, "From today on, I'll cook for you. I hope you like it. I've also brought a friend — a strong and handsome lion. If you're happy, you can go find him to play." 

"Really?" the prince was overjoyed, because rarely anyone wanted to play with him, and he always felt quite lonely. "Where is that strong and handsome lion? I really want to see him!" 

"Well —" the fat bear cook tied her apron and said, "He's not in the palace courtyard, but in the lawn outside the palace; if not there, then behind the hill; if not behind the hill, then by the small pond... go find him!" 

The prince happily rushed out. 

The fat bear cook then lit the stove, placed the pot, and began frying, stir-frying, boiling, and stewing — showcasing her skills.
summary_zh: 胖熊厨娘第一天上班，告诉王子她会为他做饭，并带来了一只又壮实又漂亮的狮子作为朋友，王子非常高兴，立刻飞奔出去寻找狮子。随后，胖熊厨娘开始在厨房里忙碌地准备饭菜。

title_en: Prince of 26 Tofu Strips and Fat Bear Chef
source_file: 26豆腐干丝王子和胖熊厨娘（7-10岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
将近中午的时候，王子满头大汗地回来了。他问胖熊厨娘：“那些地方我都找遍了，怎么没找到那只壮实又漂亮的狮子？”

“也许——”胖熊厨娘边端菜边说，“也许他在王宫后面的小树林里，不在小树林里，就在小溪流边上……你吃完饭再去找吧。”

王子看了一眼满桌的菜，有说：“咦！我的豆腐干丝呢？今天怎么没有豆腐干丝？”

胖熊厨娘满脸满意地说：“真不好意思，也许我的豆腐干丝烧得太好吃了，一群蟑螂爬来把它偷吃了。你就将就着吃这些吧！”
page_text_en:
Near noon, the prince returned, sweating profusely. He asked the fat bear cook, "I've searched all those places, but I can't find that strong and handsome lion!"

"Perhaps—" the fat bear cook said while serving the dishes, "perhaps he's in the small forest behind the palace, or if not there, then by the little stream... you finish your meal first, then go look for him."

The prince glanced at the full table of food and said, "Huh? Where's my tofu dry strips? Why aren't there any tofu dry strips today?"

The fat bear cook smiled contentedly, "I'm so sorry, perhaps my tofu dry strips were too delicious, and a group of cockroaches crawled over and stole them. You might as well just eat these for now!"
summary_zh: 王子焦急地寻找他新交的朋友狮子，却一无所获。胖熊厨娘端来饭菜，王子发现没有他最爱的豆腐干丝，便质问厨娘。厨娘笑着解释说豆腐干丝被蟑螂偷吃了，让王子将就着吃别的菜。

title_en: Prince of 26 Tofu Strips and Fat Bear Chef
source_file: 26豆腐干丝王子和胖熊厨娘（7-10岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
王子跑了半天，饿极了，就大口大口地吃起来。
吃完了，他抹抹嘴说：“这是什么菜？挺好吃的。”
胖熊厨娘笑着说：“炒菠菜、煎豆腐、烧肉丸子，还有清蒸鲜鱼……”
“真好吃！”王子说，“不过，我还是想吃豆腐干丝。”
王子吃完又出门了，去寻找他的那位没见面的朋友。
一直到太阳落山，月亮升上天空时，王子才气喘吁吁地回来。他对胖熊厨娘说：“怎么还不见那只狮子？”
page_text_en:
The prince ran for half a day, got extremely hungry, and started eating big mouthfuls.
After finishing, he wiped his mouth and said, “What is this dish? It’s really delicious.”
The plump bear cook smiled and said, “Stir-fried spinach, pan-fried tofu, braised meatballs, and steamed fresh fish…”
“Delicious!” the prince said, “But I still want to eat tofu strips.”
After finishing his meal, the prince went out again to look for his friend he hadn’t met yet.
Until the sun set and the moon rose into the sky, the prince finally returned, panting. He said to the plump bear cook, “Why haven’t I seen that lion yet?”
summary_zh: 王子吃完饭后出门寻找他新交的朋友狮子，但直到太阳落山、月亮升起才气喘吁吁地回来，质问胖熊厨娘为何还没见到狮子。

title_en: Prince of 26 Tofu Strips and Fat Bear Chef
source_file: 26豆腐干丝王子和胖熊厨娘（7-10岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
“也许他迷路了。”胖熊厨娘一边端上菜来，一边说，“饿了吧？快吃饭，明天他准来，明天再找吧。”
王子确实累极了，饿极了，他端起碗来大口大口地吃着，吃得香极了。
吃完了，他才开口说：“怎么又没有豆腐干丝啊？”
胖熊厨娘不好意思地说：“真对不起，也许是我的豆腐干丝烧得太鲜美了，跑来一群老鼠，把它给偷吃了。”
王子二话没说，就去睡觉了。
第二天一早，胖熊厨娘走进王子卧室一看，早没人影了，准是又去找那位朋友了。
王子中午回来的时候，饿得眼冒金星，瞧见桌子上香喷喷的饭菜，他几乎想连桌子一起吃掉。
page_text_en:
"Maybe he got lost," said the fat bear cook, bringing the dishes and saying, "You must be hungry? Eat quickly, he'll surely come tomorrow, and we'll look for him then." 

The prince was indeed exhausted and starving. He picked up his bowl and ate greedily, savoring every bite. 

After finishing, he finally said, "Why is there no tofu-dry-silkworm again?" 

The fat bear cook said apologetically, "I'm so sorry. Maybe my tofu-dry-silkworm was too delicious, and a group of mice came and stole it." 

The prince said nothing and went straight to sleep. 

The next morning, the fat bear cook entered the prince's bedroom and found no one there. He must have gone to look for that friend again. 

When the prince returned at noon, he was starving, his eyes spinning with hunger. Seeing the delicious food on the table, he almost wanted to eat the table too.
summary_zh: 王子因未吃到豆腐干丝而质问胖熊厨娘，厨娘谎称被老鼠偷吃。王子睡觉后第二天一早不见人影，厨娘推测他去找朋友。中午王子饿着肚子回来，看到饭菜后几乎想连桌子一起吃掉。

title_en: Prince of 26 Tofu Strips and Fat Bear Chef
source_file: 26豆腐干丝王子和胖熊厨娘（7-10岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
吃完了,他抹抹嘴,又忙着出门寻找。

一连五天过去了。

到了第六天中午,王子吃完饭放下碗。

胖熊厨娘跟王子说:“我今天第一次给你送上豆腐干丝,你吃得并不多,而其他菜却吃了不少。”

“是啊。”王子挠挠脑袋说,“豆腐干丝虽然好吃,可是其他菜更好吃,我从前为什么不爱吃呢?真傻!”
page_text_en:
He finished eating, wiped his mouth, and hurried out to look for it.

Five days passed.

On the sixth day at noon, the prince finished his meal and put down his bowl.

The fat bear cook said to the prince, "Today, for the first time, I'm serving you tofu strips. You didn't eat much of them, but you ate a lot of the other dishes."

"That's right," the prince scratched his head and said, "Tofu strips are delicious, but the other dishes are even better. Why didn't I like them before? How silly I was!"
summary_zh: 王子连续五天未找到狮子，第六天中午吃完饭后，胖熊厨娘告诉他今天第一次为他准备了豆腐干丝，王子意识到自己以前不爱吃豆腐干丝是愚蠢的。

title_en: Prince of 26 Tofu Strips and Fat Bear Chef
source_file: 26豆腐干丝王子和胖熊厨娘（7-10岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
就在“豆腐干丝王子”又想出门
去寻找那只狮子的时候，他突然对胖
熊厨娘说：“你的那只又壮实又漂亮
的狮子究竟在哪儿？为什么总是找不
到？”
“他确实存在。”胖熊厨娘说，“不
过他现在不在外面，就在宫里，就在这
走廊的尽头，不信你去找找看。”
王子迫不及待地冲向走廊的尽
头。
走廊尽头什么也没有，只有一面
大大的亮亮的穿衣镜，“豆腐干丝王
子”终于看见了，镜子里面有一只狮
子——
page_text_en:
Just as "Tofu Dry Strip Prince" wanted to go out
again to look for that lion, he suddenly said to the fat
bear cook, "Where exactly is your strong and beautiful
lion? Why can't I ever find him?"
"He definitely exists," the fat bear cook said, "but
he's not outside now. He's in the palace, right at the
end of the corridor. Don't believe me? Go look for yourself."
The prince rushed迫不及待ly toward the end of the corridor.
There was nothing at the end of the corridor, only a
big, bright dressing mirror. "Tofu Dry Strip Prince" finally saw it—inside the mirror was a lion—
summary_zh: 王子再次寻找他的狮子朋友，胖熊厨娘告诉他狮子就在宫里的走廊尽头。王子冲过去，却发现尽头只有一面穿衣镜，镜中映出一只狮子。

title_en: Prince of 26 Tofu Strips and Fat Bear Chef
source_file: 26豆腐干丝王子和胖熊厨娘（7-10岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
这只狮子竖起满头蓬松的鬣毛，
又壮实，又神气，又英俊。
不知什么时候，胖熊厨娘已经站在王子身旁了，她说：“再也没有人会叫你‘豆腐干丝王子’了，你的名字叫威风凛凛·十分英俊·万分聪明王子。”
王子高兴得紧紧拥抱住这位有魔法的胖熊厨娘，劲儿大得让胖熊厨娘都透不过气来了。
page_text_en:
This lion stood tall with his fluffy mane, 
strong, spirited, and handsome. 
Without knowing when, the fat bear cook had already stood beside the prince. She said, "No one will ever call you 'Tofu Dry Strip Prince' again. Your name is now Majestic, Handsome, and Extremely Clever Prince." 
The prince happily hugged the magical fat bear cook tightly, so hard that even the cook couldn't breathe.
summary_zh: 王子在镜子中看到自己变成了一只威风凛凛的狮子，胖熊厨娘告诉他从此不再叫他‘豆腐干丝王子’，并为他取了新名字，王子高兴地紧紧拥抱厨娘。

title_en: Prince of 26 Tofu Strips and Fat Bear Chef
source_file: 26豆腐干丝王子和胖熊厨娘（7-10岁）.pptx
summary_zh: 画面中，一只穿着紫色裙子的狮子与一位穿着围裙的胖熊紧紧拥抱，表情温馨，背景简洁，传达出亲密友好的情感。
